headline: Palworld oil rig locations
title: Palworld Oil Rig Locations | Easy Barge Rig and Main Stronghold | Palworld Guide
video_script: Need crude oil in Palworld? Start with the Barge Oil Rig, around level thirty. It's in the lake north of the Sealed Realm of the Frozen Wings, at about one sixty, minus two eighty. It only has gun turrets and no anti air lasers, so you can fly straight in. The big Oil Rig stronghold is around level fifty five, southeast of Marsh Island. There's no fast travel point on it, so warp to Marsh Island and fly or swim over. Which rig do you farm? Comment below!
description: Palworld 1.0 oil rigs: the Barge Oil Rig (level ~30) in the lake north of the Sealed Realm of the Frozen Wings around (160, -280) - turrets only, fly in; the main Oil Rig stronghold (level ~55) southeast of Marsh Island - warp to Marsh Island first.
